result.title: Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
result.summary: Learning and inference on time series can pose significant statistical challenges, including autocorrelated observations, distribution shift over time, and the curse of dimensionality. These challenges complicate the practical application of causal discovery algorithms, which already suffer from high computational and sample complexity in the general case. To mitigate these issues, this work introduces Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery (ITPD): a sound and complete constraint-based procedure for causal structure learning on multivariate time series with causal nonstationarity. ITPD takes a local-to-global learning approach that discovers the global graph by sequentially discovering the parent set for each variable. ITPD exploits temporal structural priors, graph partitioning, and the local Markov condition to swap higher-order conditional independence tests for lower-order alternatives. With an exact oracle, ITPD performed the least number of tests and used the smallest average conditioning set sizes relative to baselines. In benchmarking simulations, ITPD sat on the Pareto frontier with respect to F1 and wall-clock time and was faster than baselines on large graphs ($\geq$ 1000 nodes). For graphs with 2000 nodes, ITPD ran $2.3\times$, $9.1\times$, and $40.9\times$ faster than iterative IAMB, DF-PC, and PCMCI, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 ITPD，一种面向因果非平稳多变量时间序列的约束式因果结构学习算法，以「先局部、后全局」的方式逐个变量确定父集，并借助时间结构先验、图划分与局部 Markov 条件，用低阶条件独立检验替代高阶检验，在仿真中取得 F1 与耗时的 Pareto 优势。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文与 LVR 主线不直接相关，但其「局部确定因果父集、以低阶检验替代高阶检验」的思路，可能为「哪些历史或视觉证据应进入推理状态、如何低成本筛选因果相关成分」提供问题表述层面的启发，可供核查。
